about:
Allweld Metal Fabrication Inc. is a family-owned welders' shop based in Napa, California. The company was founded in 2010 and has operated as a local fabrication business since then, serving the surrounding region with custom metalwork.

The shop provides metal fabrication and welding services, handling custom fabrication projects for industrial clients. Its capabilities span metal fabrication and welding, with the shop offering free estimates for projects in the Napa area. The business operates from a facility in Napa, though square footage and employee count are not disclosed. Specific processes include welding and metal fabrication, though detailed equipment lists and production capacities are not publicly disclosed.

Allweld serves customers in the agricultural and automotive sectors, producing fabricated metal components and welded assemblies for equipment and vehicle applications. The company also notes its involvement as a primary sponsor of local community events, underscoring its regional ties.

The company emphasizes its roots as a local, family-owned operation, positioning itself as a neighborhood fabrication resource for the Napa region. This identity shapes its approach to customer service and project collaboration, with a focus on responsive communication and flexible scheduling.
